added_functions.definition: function symbols present in head and absent from base after package and receiver matching

added_helper_calls.definition: call expressions whose identifier or selector name matches a function added from base to head

changed_production_files.definition: production Go paths added, copied, modified, or renamed from a commit's first parent

clone_tokens.definition: dupl normalized syntax-token clone groups, fingerprinted without source positions

cognitive_complexity.definition: gocognit cognitive complexity for a function declaration

cyclomatic_complexity.definition: gocyclo cyclomatic complexity for a function declaration

file_lines.definition: physical lines in a non-generated Go source file

function_lines.definition: physical lines from func declaration start through body end, inclusive

function_statements.definition: AST statement nodes excluding block and empty statements

functions_per_kloc.definition: function declarations per 1000 physical source lines

micro_function_statements.definition: function with no more than this many non-block AST statements

package_file_count.definition: non-generated Go source files in one package
